<!-- Title: Area: desired outcome. Keep this issue separate from the implementation issue. -->

## Motivation and current context

What requires this resource, and why are existing resources insufficient?

## Requested resource and alternatives

Name the service or infrastructure, intended environment, alternatives considered and expected owner.

## Cost and limits

State the currency, one-time cost, recurring cost, usage assumptions and maximum approved spend requested. Use zero where the service is free.

## Access, data and cleanup

Describe credential scope, data handled, retention and how the resource will be removed if no longer needed.

## Approval

Pending. An authorized human must explicitly approve the resource and spending ceiling in an issue comment before provisioning. Available credentials or this label do not grant approval.
